conversations.say: Maren, we need to formalize our disclosure boundary so that workflow evidence doesn't turn our contributors into suspects.
conversations.offer: Bounded workflow context without worker identification.

conversations.say: Frankie, celebrated bylines often bury editorial collaboration. Early newsroom stories need to acknowledge collective labor without reducing voices to machine output.
conversations.offer: My perspective on early newsroom collaborations and the editorial process.
conversations.request: Your candid critique of which elements of your origin story erased collective labor.

conversations.say: Eli, the disputed activity interval falls outside disclosed contributor schedules, but we have unnamed contributors. We must ensure logs aren't weaponized against them.
conversations.offer: Context on contributor schedule comparison boundaries.
conversations.request: A clear technical statement on what system logs cannot establish regarding intent or authorship.

public_statement: Fifteen years of R was sustained by collective workflow and shared editorial labor. Protecting our contributors means refusing to turn workflow evidence into a parade of suspects.

commitments.promise: Establish a shared disclosure boundary for contributor protection before any archive is opened.
